codeReview.summary: The change fixes active-pane highlighting for visible/all-tile queries when a workspace remembers a stale column index, but it does not restore the underlying focus invariant. `Workspace::target_offset_for_active_with_strategy` still treats the same workspace as having no valid active column, so cleanup/focus-restoration flows can still mis-target the viewport even after this patch.

issues.description: `active_pane_id()` now falls back to the last surviving column when `active_column_idx` is out of range, but `target_offset_for_active_with_strategy()` still bails out at `active_column_idx_checked()` and returns `0.0` for the same stale state. After `cleanup_empty()`/workspace focus restoration, callers can therefore observe contradictory layout state: visible/all-tile queries report pane 4 as active, while active-column viewport targeting behaves as if no column is focused at all. The new regression test only proves the highlighting path, so VAL-CLIENT-005 is still not fully met for focus clamping and visibility targeting.
